verdict.statement: Under both q_a/kv_a eps conventions the engine passes spec §21.2 items 3-4 at event 1 (kappa=2 and kappa=1); no convention was found under which it fails or under which the legacy's absolute bias is smaller than the engine's. Bias signs/sizes are convention-dependent, so no 'more accurate' claim is made. The seven swaps are boundary noise within the legacy's own error against the model; the layer-1 defect hypothesis is not supported.
